  "cons": [
    "The admin console being separate from the password manager can be a bit disjointed.",
    "Initial setup for team management and organization structure might require some learning.",
    "The free tier's strict user and collection limits are immediately restrictive for larger teams."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Systems Administrator likely found Bitwarden to be a highly functional and secure solution for consolidating and administering passwords and MFA codes across their 51-200 employee company. Its robust sharing, organization, and cross-platform capabilities were valuable, offering significant bang for the buck. While the UI and administrative workflows might have felt less polished or slightly disjointed compared to some alternatives, its core security and management features met their needs effectively."
